verdict.rationale: AgentMail's evidence documents only email inboxes: send/receive, threads, IMAP/SMTP, webhooks and WebSockets. Nothing shows SMS, WhatsApp, social, or live-chat channels handled in the same inbox. A community user asking whether it would expand to phone numbers is a question, not support, and the LiveKit guide only adds email to a voice agent. Omnichannel inboxes are a fair question for an inbox product, so the axis applies and the verdict is none.

support.subject: As a team-lead, the same inbox also handles adjacent customer channels — SMS, WhatsApp, social, or live chat — beside email
